name: Atura
detailed_description:
Atura is a relaxing yet challenging strategy and puzzle game where you take on the role of a skilled herding dog. Set in a peaceful, nature-inspired world with a charming low-poly, paper-craft art style. Navigate intricate courses, adapt to the unpredictable behavior of the sheep, and master the art of shepherding through thoughtful movement and strategy.

Whether looking for a calm, immersive experience or a test of precision and planning, Atura provides a unique take on herding, rewarding players who can guide their flock efficiently and with care.

In Atura, you control a herding dog from a third-person perspective using simple and intuitive controls. There is no steep learning curve—move, position yourself strategically, and gently guide the flock through each course.

Every level introduces new challenges, from varied terrain and natural obstacles to dynamic sheep behavior that requires quick thinking and adaptability. Success comes from precise movement and efficient pathfinding, which turns each completed trial into a satisfying achievement. Whether optimizing your approach for the best results or simply enjoying the rhythm of herding, Atura offers a rewarding experience at your pace.

short_description: Guide a herd of sheep as a herding dog. Use timing and precision to navigate obstacles and complete each trial. Master the art of sheep herding and adapt to unpredictable animal behavior. Relaxing yet engaging, this game will test your skills and quick thinking in a unique and natural setting.
